title: Representative validation workloads
status: Adopted workload specifications; no results measured

measurementPolicy.hardware: Record CPU/cores/RAM/SSD/power/OS/build/GPU/display and binary/dependency digests. Reference latency/RSS budgets assume a 16-GiB SSD workstation; publish constrained-device results separately.
measurementPolicy.samples: 20 fresh-process starts; at least 1000 queries after recorded warmup for latency distributions. Include failures, p50/p95/p99 and sample count.
measurementPolicy.cache: Cold-process is a fresh app, not a promise of cold filesystem caches. Record OS cache state.
measurementPolicy.corpora: Freeze seed/generator/version, source digests/counts/topology/dimensions and relevance labels. Synthetic scale does not prove extraction semantics.
measurementPolicy.inference: Precomputed/scripted fixtures only. Live E2E is separately dispatched later.
measurementPolicy.memory: Report core and helper/browser/compiler process-tree RSS and GPU memory separately and combined.

provisionalBudgets.status: Initial engineering targets on reference hardware; calibrate on first actual build and record reasons for changes. No performance pass or confirmed product measurement.

workloads.title: Clean installation and idle
workloads.corpus: Empty workspace with optional tools/model endpoints absent
workloads.parameters: 20 fresh-process starts; ten-minute settled idle window
workloads.metrics: first interactive frame, installed bytes, core/process-tree RSS, CPU per core, dynamic dependencies

workloads.title: Planning and history
workloads.metrics: page/filter/edit p50/p95/p99, SQLite/WAL size, RSS, scope correctness

workloads.title: Transcript and UI streaming
workloads.corpus: 100000-message conversation with variable text/code and attachments
workloads.metrics: input/frame p95/p99, scroll stalls, durable chunk lag, rendered rows, RSS

workloads.title: Incremental extraction
workloads.corpus: 500 files/50000 LOC and 10000 files/1000000 LOC; mixed-language frozen sources
workloads.parameters: 1 percent edits; 0.2 percent rename/delete; each semantic pack separately
workloads.metrics: full/incremental wall time, bytes/files per second, core/helper RSS, publication/cancellation correctness

workloads.title: Graph queries
workloads.corpus: 100000 and 1000000 seeded nodes at mean five edges per node, cycles/hubs/cross-repo links; 5000000-node stretch
workloads.parameters: search, call path, impact, architecture, dependencies at depths 1/3/6
workloads.metrics: cold-process/warm p50/p95/p99, visited edges, truncation, I/O, scope violations, RSS

workloads.title: Overlay publication
workloads.corpus: Ten divergent worktrees across two projects sharing a baseline
workloads.parameters: 100 changed files per view; moving base during publication
workloads.metrics: refresh latency, overlay bytes, pin lifetime, wrong-view results, retries

workloads.title: Document retrieval
workloads.corpus: 1000/10000 text/PDF/DOCX documents plus scanned-page fixtures; 100000/250000 chunks
workloads.parameters: 384/1536-dimension precomputed vectors; top 10; scripted extraction, no inference
workloads.metrics: lexical/vector p95, labeled recall, citation accuracy, scope violations, disk/RSS, reindex time

workloads.title: Queue saturation and recovery
workloads.corpus: 100000 pending events with four consumers each; ordered and independent partitions
workloads.metrics: oldest eligible age, delivery lag p95/p99, duplicate effects, control-write latency, backlog bytes, restart time

workloads.title: Concurrent application load
workloads.corpus: Ten work roots with independent default worker allowances, indexing and graph reads
workloads.parameters: 20 scripted streams; 32 active tool calls; 10000 queued jobs
workloads.metrics: UI/control admission p95, storage fairness, queue lag, core/process-tree RSS, no missed acknowledged outcomes

workloads.title: Faults and resource pressure
workloads.corpus: Commit/publication/dispatch/ack kill points; low disk and unavailable providers/helpers/key stores
workloads.parameters: before commit; after commit before wakeup; after external fixture commit before ack
workloads.metrics: lost acknowledged records, duplicate unsafe effects, Unknown reconciliation, independent progress, Continue/restore holds

workloads.title: Packages and external tools
workloads.corpus: Every contribution fixture and local/remote MCP fixtures
workloads.parameters: 20 instances; 10000 replayed events; failed required/optional hooks and updates
workloads.metrics: pressure, hook latency, quiescence, registry/state identity, revocation, process leakage

workloads.title: Native platform capabilities
workloads.corpus: Every adopted OS/CPU/display row and optional helper/browser/desktop/container separately
workloads.parameters: native hardware for actual graphics/accessibility/power/isolation claims
workloads.metrics: startup/idle/install by target, permissions, helper coverage, owned-resource shutdown
